name: Romanian Cubing Open 2019

venue.name: [Vivo Center](https://vivo-shopping.com/ro/cluj) (fostul Polus)
venue.details: t.b.a (Entrance 3 or 1 - Food Court - still under discussion with the Mall. Distance is only 100m between entrances)

information:
At the registration you can support the association "Asociatia Romana de Speedcubing" with a contribution and you will get a cubing prize.

Prizes
Certificates and medals for top 3 of each event and for the fastest girl, youngest competitor, oldest competitor and fastest competitor of each country (who register until 5.04.2019.)
